title: Christlike Service
definition: Christlike Service is the Christlike use of strength, gifts, time, and resources for the good of people and the glory of God.
summary: Christian service flows from love and the example of Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus Christ came not to be served but to serve, and He empowers His people to serve in His name.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Christlike Service describes a Spirit-formed pattern of life for those who belong to Jesus Christ. Christian living is not an attempt to earn salvation but the grateful response of people who have been saved by grace and called to walk with the Lord.

Scripture presents this truth so believers can grow in holiness, endurance, love, wisdom, worship, and mission. It touches the heart, the mind, the tongue, relationships, daily habits, and faithful obedience in ordinary life.

The emphasis of this doctrine is christian service flows from love and the example of jesus.. It points disciples away from self-reliance and toward abiding dependence on Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because discipleship can become shallow when it is reduced to information, emotion, or outward activity alone. Christlike Service teaches believers how grace becomes visible in daily conduct, perseverance, relationships, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask the Lord to form this truth in you through Scripture, prayer, repentance, and faithful practice. Let christlike service shape how you think, speak, serve, endure, forgive, and represent Christ in the places God has assigned to you.
